Name: Sheara, The Weightless

Rarity/Attunement: Artifact (Warhammer), Yes

"I wield the great breaker, heavy with force, yet light as a feather. I raise it high, and let it fall low upon my foes."

Description: A steel handled warhammer with a thin small head made entirely of celestial gold. It glows slightly, and when swung it jingles like wind chimes. On its handle are blue cloth wrappings stitched with golden feathers.

Effects: +2 Warhammer. While attuned to this item you gain the following effects:
- Searing Radiance: Melee attacks with this weapon do an additional 1d8 radiant damage.
- Wallbreaker: Attacks made with this weapon against structures of an abyssal nature or material are automatic critical hits.
- Eyes of Oteus: You gain truesight over 5ft.
